There are always many people at the night market. Last Friday, Grace and Lily went to the old town. Grace and Lily had great fun there. Best of all, a deer stood at the edge of the forest.

Grace plays baseball with Lily every Friday. Grace is reading a book about English. Grace thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Also, doctors will transplant a healthy kidney next week.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the old town by bike. They took many photos at the night market. Life is full of small surprises. What's more, this juice contains natural sugar.
Grace is going to travel to Tokyo in May. The weather was snowy that day. Lily is interested in drawing.
